systems.system: Système d'Information et de Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Éducation Nationale et de l'Alphabétisation (its Direction des Technologies et des Systèmes d'Information speaks for it); financed by the Millennium Challenge Corporation's Skills for Employability and Productivity programme
systems.tiers: officially launched and handed over on 10 July 2025; tested in the pilot regions of Bouaké and San Pedro; to be generalised nationally, the minister appealing to bilateral, multilateral and private partners to fund it

note: SIGE is described by what the ministry will be able to do with it (follow children's schooling across the territory, plan buildings, allocate staff, fight dropout) and as piloted in two regions; the article does not say that schools enter per-learner records, nor that it is a yearly return, so it is left unclassified and gives no fact. If the parent classes SIGE as emis on other evidence, this document carries a dated launch (2025-07-10), a two-region pilot, MCC finance and an unfunded national rollout.
